You don't have the velvet sofa anymore — the olive green Article Sven went to your sister's place in December, and your living room now has the 15-year-old brown leather L-shaped sectional you inherited from your uncle. Leather doesn't need pile brushing; for crushed or tired-looking cushions, plump and rotate them and treat the dry leather with a light cream conditioner buffed in with a soft cloth. If you're actually asking on your sister's behalf, velvet pile is revived by steaming lightly and brushing with a soft garment or velvet brush in the direction of the nap.
